messages:
mika: Heads up — after rolling strict fncall validation to canary-4 were seeing a cluster of structured-output errors and a small downstream billing delta. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/board/fncall-errors
leo_ops: Can you share a compact example?
mika: sample entry:
```
{"req_id":"req_6ee1","route":"canary-4","fncall":"summarize_v2","status":"fallback","reason":"malformed_json_array","adapter":"rust-adapter@0.9","tokens_billed":33}
```
jen: looks like adapter returned an array where the schema expects an object. is this a model halluc or adapter bug?
telemetry-bot: Alert: fncall_structured_errors_total > 40 in 30m for canary-4 (severity: warning)
leo_ops: Two quick asks: 1) we need reason enums (malformed_json_array is okay but confirm canonical name), 2) console should show "fallback vs hard-reject" and whether its due to adapter vs model.
mika: short-term mitigation I propose:
- mute billing spike for canary-4 for 1h
- flip canary slice back to 50% strict_validate if we don't see fix within 30m
- enable detailed trace sampling at 2% for structured errors
- mark Console rows with `error_origin: adapter|model` if available
cs_omar: CS notes: customers keep seeing "function failed" in flows and are raising support tickets. need wording in Console: "Output shape mismatch: automatic fallback applied (may increase tokens)"
jen: engineering note: adapter team patched a coercion path last week that could have introduced array-coercion. I'll open a quick rollback PR for rust-adapter@0.9 -> @0.8 and run canary smoke tests.
leo_ops: telemetry change: emit `fncall_structured_errors_total{route,reason_enum,origin=adapter|model,route_tier=hosted|dedicated}`. also add `billing_owner=source_route`.
mika: agreed. who owns the metric name migration?
leo_ops: I'll own the PR and coordinate with billing for a nonbreaking tag migration. We'll keep old metric (fncall_structured_errors_total_raw) for 48h and emit new one in parallel.
jen: I'll file the adapter rollback and link to this thread.
cs_omar: I'll draft the Console copy and CS canned responses.
mika: action items: leo_ops -> metrics enum PR + mute alert; jen -> adapter rollback PR; cs_omar -> Console messaging; telemetry-bot -> keep alerting if > 30 after mute window.
mika: thanks everyone. updating ticket and will post follow-up in 30m.
